en_before: On a small budget, avoid buying an entire set because its listing says Alt. Prioritize reusable pieces: distinctive bottoms such as cargos, wide jeans, or a mini skirt; a textured or graphic top; then footwear and accessories. Ask whether it works in three outfits, suits your preferred proportions, and remains useful without accessories. For a practical sequence, see Alternative Fashion for Beginners.
